description.value: Chubby Duck's is a casual kebab and poutine spot in Whistler Village, notable for serving exclusively certified halal meats alongside falafel and vegetarian options. Located in Village Green, it caters to a late-night crowd and offers online ordering. A touring cyclist looking for a quick, filling meal with halal or vegetarian options will find a solid selection here.

address.value: Unit 9, 4122 Village Green, Whistler, BC V8E1G9
